Usage: arcctl [global flags] <command> [flags] [args]

Commands:
  doctor      check permissions, the receiver, other HID clients and the lock
  info        show the device: online state, versions, battery, model, tiers
  trace       print every input report of every interface; sends nothing
  dump        read flash and print it as hex, raw bytes or decoded
  backup      save a backup of the mouse configuration
  backups     list the saved backups
  show        decode a backup, web .bin or dump; no device needed
  diff        compare two backups, or a backup with the device, per record
  export-bin  write a web app compatible .bin (16448 bytes)
  redact      copy a --record transcript with private bytes masked, for sharing
  version     show the version, catalog inputs, verified stages, usbhid patches
  help        show help

Global flags (before or after the command):
  -ascii
      print only ASCII
  -backend backend
      HID backend: usbhid, or hidapi in builds with that tag
  -device path
      use the interface at this path (required when several answer)
  -emulate file
      no hardware: emulate a mouse holding this backup, web .bin or dump file
  -log file
      append the session log to file
  -model key
      model key of a dump or .bin, as in 'arcctl info' (default 7B04)
  -no-color
      no colour (the CLI prints none)
  -os os
      key names for os: mac or win (default: this computer's)
  -record file
      record the HID traffic as a transcript to file; a bare name goes in the
      logs folder
  -replay file
      no hardware: play back this recorded transcript file
  -wait duration
      how long to wait for a sleeping mouse, or while replies go missing
      (default 10s)

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage, 3 no receiver, 4 mouse offline,
5 permission, 6 locked, seized, other client or stalled, 8 aborted,
9 several devices answer (pass --device).
